chunks: Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd al-Minqarī narrated from Ḥafṣ ibn Ghiyāth, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: Who carries out the hudud, the ruler or the judge? He said: “The carrying out of the hudud belongs to the one to whom judgment belongs.”
The Book of Hudud is complete, and following it is the Book of Blood-Money and Retaliation.
ai.seo_question: Who has the authority to carry out the hudud in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the authority to carry out the hudud belongs to the one who possesses judicial authority. It addresses the locus of legal enforcement within the system of الحكم. The closing sentence marks the end of the section on hudud in the book.
